# Ultrastable seed

> The code-only kernel a new autonomous system starts from: bootstrapper, tick Worker, roles, agent instructions and the loops that take it to criticality. A copy of seed/ in the Ultrastable platform.

Every tick the system reconciles its state, takes its highest-priority item, does it, verifies it through an independent path, scores the prediction it logged and files the next improvement.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what it is, where it runs and how it runs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for any coding agent
- [SYSTEM.md](SYSTEM.md): what the system is, generated from its code
- [IDEA.md](IDEA.md): the one file a person writes
- [ultrastable.json](ultrastable.json): the manifest this file, the README blocks, CITATION.cff, publiccode.yml and codemeta.json are rendered from
- [codemeta.json](codemeta.json): software metadata (CodeMeta 3.0)

## Code

- [bootstrap/bootstrap.py](bootstrap/bootstrap.py): boot stages from idea to running system
- [worker/src/index.js](worker/src/index.js): the Worker's routes
- [worker/src/tick.js](worker/src/tick.js): the heartbeat
- [autonomy/policy.json](autonomy/policy.json): what the system may do on its own
- [autonomy/repo-conformance.json](autonomy/repo-conformance.json): the files every repository carries
- [scripts/surfaces.py](scripts/surfaces.py): renders this file and the other identity files from ultrastable.json
